children: BitTorrent has launched its brand upgrade and completed its first-quarter BTT buyback and burn. According to ChainCatcher, 100% of Q3 revenue from decentralized services was used to repurchase and permanently burn 21,621,611,570,729.6 BTT. The unified BitTorrent brand brings together content distribution, decentralized AI inference computing services and Layer 2 infrastructure.

title: BitTorrent Launches Brand Upgrade, Completes First-Quarter BTT Buyback and Burn
